args:
set -e
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
if [ -f /opt/ros2_cam_ws/install/setup.bash ]; then
  source /opt/ros2_cam_ws/install/setup.bash
fi
ros2 run camera_driver_pkg camera_driver --ros-args \
  -p device:="/dev/video0" \
  -p width:=1280 \
  -p height:=720 \
  -p fps:=0 \
  -p frame_id:="camera" \
  -p synthetic_mode:="false" \
  -p image_topic:="/camera/image_raw"
containers.name: camera

command:
FULLNAME="microservices-pattern"
NS="ros2exp"
PEERS=""
PEERS="$PEERS ${FULLNAME}-camera-0.${FULLNAME}-camera-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
PEERS="$PEERS ${FULLNAME}-yolo-0.${FULLNAME}-yolo-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
PEERS="$PEERS ${FULLNAME}-llava-0.${FULLNAME}-llava-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
PEERS="$PEERS ${FULLNAME}-voxtral-0.${FULLNAME}-voxtral-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
for PEER in $PEERS; do
  echo "[init] Waiting for DDS peer DNS: $PEER"
  until nslookup "$PEER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "[init]   $PEER not resolvable yet, retrying in 3s..."
    sleep 3
  done
  echo "[init]   $PEER resolved"
done
GRACE=60
echo "[init] All peer DNS resolved — waiting ${GRACE}s for nodes to finish loading models and start publishing"
sleep "$GRACE"
echo "[init] Ready to start rosbridge"
initContainers.name: wait-for-peers

args:
set -e
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
if [ -f /opt/ros_ws/install/setup.bash ]; then
  source /opt/ros_ws/install/setup.bash
fi
ros2 run llava_pkg llava_node --ros-args \
  -p model_id:=${LLAVA_MODEL_ID} \
  -p image_topic:="${IMAGE_TOPIC}" \
  -p detection_topic:="${DETECTIONS_TOPIC}" \
  -p trigger_topic:="${LLAVA_TRIGGER_TOPIC}" \
  -p response_topic:="${LLAVA_RESPONSE_TOPIC}" \
  -p latency_topic:="${LLAVA_LATENCY_TOPIC}" \
  -p inference_topic:="${LLAVA_INFERENCE_TOPIC}" \
  -p trigger_on_yolo:=${LLAVA_TRIGGER_ON_YOLO} \
  -p yolo_trigger_interval_s:=$(printf "%.1f" "${LLAVA_YOLO_INTERVAL_S}") \
  -p max_new_tokens:=${LLAVA_MAX_TOKENS} \
  -p load_in_4bit:=${LLAVA_LOAD_4BIT} &
LLAVA_PID=$!
python3 /opt/scripts/resource_monitor.py &
MONITOR_PID=$!
wait -n ${LLAVA_PID} ${MONITOR_PID}
exit 1
containers.name: llava
